$comment: Per-human deployment records driven by elohim/holochain/Jenkinsfile. All humans now run the consolidated single-container pattern (elohim-node) — see genesis/orchestrator/manifests/humans/_edgenode-consolidated.template.yaml for the shared template. Adam uses an explicit manifest file (the historical reference impl); everyone else sed-renders the template. See genesis/plans/2026-04-16-elohim-node-consolidation-design.md for background and 2026-04-21-consolidate-human-deployments.md for the migration that retired the legacy 4-container pattern. The edgenode{Memory,Cpu}{Request,Limit} fields are THE source of truth for per-human conductor resource budgets — each set is tied to a deviceArchetype from genesis/plans/2026-04-13-device-archetypes-design.md. Treat these as the archetype's validated minimum; when bumped temporarily to unblock work, leave an entry-level $comment noting the intended floor and the follow-up that restores it.

humans.$comment: Introduced 2026-05-18 alongside shem-return reshuffle. Gertrude formalizes the 'grandma standard' archetype that has shaped the resilience epic — the non-technical user who must be served well (memory: project_recovery_grandma_standard, project_subsume_g_f_a_via_it_just_works). She is the reciprocal-recovery counterparty for the Dowell household: gertrude ↔ matthew/jessica/james hold each other's Shamir-split shares for social-derived recovery (memory: project_socially_derived_security, project_graduated_recovery_authority). Dowell-side hub is matthew's device-family-node-base (on-prem family hub); gertrude is modeled here as her always-on hub-class device (device-home-nuc) — she also has a laptop in real life, but the per-human-multi-device topology isn't modeled in deployments yet; the hub holds the Shamir share so the backup relationship is exercisable from this one entry. We have not yet hit high-availability or fully-realized backup, but this single reciprocal relationship is enough to test the full recovery/sharding/login story surface. Structural schema for these stewardship agreements deferred — captured first in canonical stories under genesis/data/stories/ until the field shape crystallizes; humans.schema.json is protocol-law and any extension wants story-first justification.
humans.name: gertrude
humans.affinityComment: Gertrude: separate household (household-gertrude, Sunset Acres) — remote-peer hub on shem; reciprocal-recovery counterparty for the Dowell family hub (matthew); always-on hub-class to hold Shamir share + serve backup/recovery flows; laptop second-device deferred until per-human-multi-device topology exists; large-text / simple-navigation accessibility needs; performance fallback to ethosengine.
